data.text:
PM Modi to likely visit #CRPark today; traffic advisory issued!

PM Modi is likely to visit the Durga Puja pandal at Kali Mandir in Chittaranjan Park today on the occasion of  #DurgaAshtami. 

Meanwhile, a traffic advisory has already been issued by @DelhiPolice with restrictions continuing to remain in effect till Oct 2.

Ahead of the visit, the SPG reportedly carried out a security check in the area on Monday. Residents were instructed to remove parked vehicles from main roads, while local hawkers were asked to temporarily shift to ease crowd flow around the pandal.

#TrafficAdvisory #DelhiTraffic #Ashtami

data.text:
❗️🌀🇻🇳 - Typhoon Bualoi struck Vietnam's coast on September 29, 2025, causing widespread destruction, killing 13 people, and injuring 46. 

The storm, which weakened into a depression as it moved toward Laos, brought strong winds, heavy rains, and 8-meter waves, damaging over 44,000 homes, flooding nearly 6,000 hectares of crops, and causing power outages for tens of thousands. 

Thirteen people, including fishermen, remain missing, with boats lost off Quang Tri. The government evacuated over 28,500 people and closed four airports, delaying or canceling hundreds of flights. 

In Ninh Binh, nine deaths and seven injuries were reported, while flooding in Hue and a falling tree in Thanh Hoa each claimed a life. 

Heavy rainfall, up to 500 mm, raised concerns about severe floods and landslides in Nghe An, Ha Tinh, and Thanh Hoa. 

Vietnam, prone to typhoons due to its South China Sea coastline, saw Bualoi cause at least 10 deaths in the Philippines prior to hitting Vietnam.
